title: Director Continuous Improvement
text:
The Continuous Improvement Director’s focus is on continuous improvement starting from our Assembly Operations to maximize our throughput and minimize cost while developing talent on Problem Solving. The position is
 
responsible for creating and implementing process improvement solutions for manufacturing of our products in the areas of on-time delivery, quality, safety and cost savings. This includes establishing metrics to achieve continuous improvement throughout the organization. The individual works closely with other departments: Operations, Lean, Manufacturing Engineering, and Industrial Engineering to develop such strategies.

Position Responsibilities:

* Assess manufacturing operations on current performance opportunities.
* Facilitate and oversight of Assembly Continuous Improvement team.
* Utilize a core-team multi-disciplinary approach in developing the strategy for driving improvement in the existing
 
 business.
* Gather and analyze internal and competitive metrics.
* Develop and drive business system policies and processes.
* Monitor existing and new core competency channels for improvement potential.
* Gain consensus and create proposals in driving heat exchanger manufacturing improvement.
* Develop true model lines that are an example of Safety, Quality and Productivity for Daikin group.
* Develop strong problem solving skills within manufacturing to quickly attack and solve manufacturing issues.
* Develop a Cost Reduction management with a constant flow of projects being scoped, staffed and implemented
 
 to achieve our productivity goals.
* Perform other duties as assigned

Nature & scope:

* Develops and implements strategic plans and objectives for the department/sub-function in an effective and innovative fashion.
* Understands the business and can put together comprehensive department solutions.
* Works with other leaders to establish strategic plans and works towards achieving them.
* Provides leadership and direction to managers in their respective division/department.
* Sees department staffing needs (e.g., interviewing, hiring, new hire and ongoing training, annual evaluations, etc.).
* Participates in budget development and monitoring of expenses.
* Level of signing authority established by company policy/guidelines.

Knowledge & Skills:

* Excellent interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills.
* Intellectual agility; ability to deal with abstract concepts and complexity comfortably.
* Ability to drive actionable plans, technical evaluations, process evaluations, product audits and other
 
 documents.
* Navigate as needed to form key partnerships with others to harmonize the Goodman Core competency.
* Prior leadership experience and a track record of driving successful improvement.
* A driven individual that functions creatively and well in a team environment.
* Data analysis skills.
* Proficiency in MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.

Competencies:

Experience:

* 10 or more years of process/quality improvement experience
* Strong business management skills and process/quality improvement experience

Education/Certification:

* A degree in Business, Engineering, or a related field from a four-year college or university is required. An advanced degree is highly preferred.

People Management:

* Yes

Physical Requirements / Work Environment:

* Must be able to perform essential responsibilities with or without reasonable accommodations

Reports To:

* VP, Assembly
